entities.summary: Lodewijk de Deyster was a Flemish draftsman, etcher, engraver, musical instrument maker and instrument maker. He painted biblical subjects and portraits. His Baroque paintings show a clear influence of Italian masters such as Giordano, Maratta, Barocci and Flemish painters like Peter Paul Rubens, Anthony van Dyck and Jan Boeckhorst. He was also a dealer in fabrics.
